draft.heroMessage: Follow Your Path in Grand Rapids Real Estate
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m Scott A Jacobs, your dedicated Realtor® in Grand Rapids, here to provide comprehensive service and guidance as you find or sell your next home.
draft.tagline: Expert negotiation. Personalized guidance. Your path, your priorities.
draft.aboutParagraph: With a background in corporate business and negotiation, I bring a results-oriented approach to real estate. Whether you’re searching for your dream home, evaluating investment opportunities, or preparing to sell, I focus on your individual needs every step of the way. I believe in being available, responsive, and proactive from first meeting to closing. Let’s connect and make your next move together in Grand Rapids.
draft.conciergeLine: Ready to chat over coffee or start your home search? Reach out any time—let’s talk about your goals.
draft.contactLine: Contact me directly at 616-481-2122 or scottaj0204@gmail.com.
draft.tone: approachable, knowledgeable, and personalized—emphasizing reliability and attentive service

websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Whether it's finding your dream home or investment properties, I can help bring together the design, community, and lifestyle you're searching for. My corporate background and locally owned brokerage offer you the negotiating skills, financial experience and real estate services you can trust. ~Scott A Jacobs

sections.title: Dream Home
sections.body: What's most important to you when buying or selling your home? Catering specifically to your needs and serving as your negotiator, we'll make your dream happen.

sections.title: WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
sections.body: Andrea Crumback "When it comes to hiring a realtor, look no further than Scott Jacobs. Scott excels at helping you sell your home (and in purchasing a new home) and goes above and beyond the call of duty to do so. Scott is always available, responsive and works very hard to get your house sold. He is a problem solver and knows the market. He is honest and compassionate and will exceed your expectations."
